news.t: PS Medico build 32 (19 Nov 2026): v18 news - typing lag fixed properly (the result sort was the bottleneck on phones AND laptops; it is now many times faster), a private admin page for the owner (open the official link with #admin, unlock once - it stays unlocked, and an Admin page button then appears in Tools), the request-code workflow removed from the user app, the strip unit converter and strip-photo scanner tools removed, and a cleaner phone layout: full-width search bar and labelled feature tiles on every phone size.
